program.name: Power Yoga Volume
program.subject: Power yoga
program.blurb: Three strong yoga practices: standing power, arm strength, then balance.
program.about: Yoga that makes you sweat. Each practice opens with sun salutations, then long standing sequences one day, chaturangas, planks and arm balances the next, and powerful balances the third. Three days rotate and each closes with a short rest. Level II brings harder poses and Level III holds them longer.
program.split: Standing power / arm strength / balance power
